# Kids and School (Thailand)

A school year has 3 money peaks (enrolment, term 1 start, term 2 start) and 1 paperwork peak (enrolment or transfer). Plan for those 4 dates; the rest is routine.

General information, not tax or legal advice — the school, เขตพื้นที่การศึกษา and กรมสรรพากร are the authorities.

## The Thai school year (public schools under สพฐ.)

| Period | Usual timing | Plan for |
|---|---|---|
| Enrolment / admission (รับนักเรียน) | ม.ค.–เม.ย.; อนุบาล/ป.1/ม.1/ม.4 have published timetables | Documents, entrance test, fees deposit |
| ภาคเรียนที่ 1 | mid-May → early October | Uniforms, books, term fees, tutoring sign-up |
| Mid-year break (ปิดภาคเรียน) | October | Camp / childcare cover |
| ภาคเรียนที่ 2 | early November → end of March | Term 2 fees, exams in Feb–Mar |
| Long break | April → mid-May | Summer course, next year's supplies |

Exact dates differ each year and for private and international schools — use the school's own calendar (ปฏิทินการศึกษา) (รอยืนยัน for any date before the school announces it).

## Fees: what is free and what is not

Public schools follow the เรียนฟรี 15 ปี policy (อนุบาล to ม.6), which funds tuition, textbooks, a uniform allowance, learning supplies and student activities — amounts per head are set by สพฐ. each year (รอยืนยัน the current figures). Parents usually still pay for: extra programmes (English Program / Gifted), extra uniforms (sports, scout), school trips, lunch top-ups, insurance, parents' association donations. Private schools charge full term fees plus a one-off entry fee.

Use [references/school-year-planner.md](references/school-year-planner.md) to lay fees out by month.

## Enrolment and transfer documents

| Document | New enrolment | Transfer (ย้ายโรงเรียน) |
|---|---|---|
| สูติบัตร (birth certificate) — copy | ✔ | |
| ทะเบียนบ้าน of child and parents — copy (some schools give priority by registered district) | ✔ | ✔ |
| บัตรประจำตัวประชาชน of parents/guardian — copy | ✔ | ✔ |
| Child's ID card (from age 7) — copy | ✔ (if issued) | ✔ |
| Photos (uniform, size per school) | ✔ | ✔ |
| ปพ.1 (transcript) from previous school | ป.1 not needed; ม.1/ม.4 ✔ | ✔ |
| Transfer letter / ใบย้าย and ปพ.1 from the old school | | ✔ |
| Vaccination record (สมุดสีชมพู) | often requested for อนุบาล | |
| Name/surname change certificate, guardianship papers if applicable | ✔ | ✔ |

Sign every copy "สำเนาถูกต้อง" and keep the originals in `personal-life` `important-docs`.

## Tutoring decision

Ask before paying: what exact gap (subject, grade, test)? For how many weeks? How will we know it worked (school mark, practice test)? Prefer short blocks (8–10 weeks) with a review over open-ended monthly fees.

## Tax and grants pointer

| Item | Amount | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Child deduction (ลดหย่อนบุตร) | 30,000 บาท/คน | Child under 20, or under 25 and studying, with income below the limit |
| Second child onward born 2561 or later | 60,000 บาท/คน | |
| Pregnancy and childbirth (ฝากครรภ์และคลอดบุตร) | up to 60,000 บาท/ครรภ์ | Receipts from hospital |
| เงินอุดหนุนเพื่อการเลี้ยงดูเด็กแรกเกิด (child support grant) | 600 บาท/เดือน to age 6 (รอยืนยัน) | Household income test; register at the local อปท. / district (รอยืนยัน current criteria) |

ตรวจล่าสุด 2026-10-06 · แหล่ง: https://www.rd.go.th · https://www.dailynews.co.th/news/5278292/ — for planning which parent claims which child, and the full list, use `trading-finance` `tax-deduction-planner`.

## Workflow

1. **Calendar** — copy the school's ปฏิทินการศึกษา into the family calendar: term starts, exam weeks, parent meetings, holidays
2. **Fees** — list every fee by month in the planner; add uniforms, books and supplies the month before term
3. **Documents** — 2 months before enrolment, run the checklist above; make 3 sets of signed copies
4. **Health** — check the vaccination record against the school's request; dental and eye checks in the April break
5. **Tutoring** — use the decision questions; review at the end of each block
6. **Tax** — at year end, collect birth certificates and hospital receipts for `trading-finance` `tax-deduction-planner`

## Worked example

2 children, public school, ป.3 and ม.1 (EP programme). Term 1 May: EP fee for ม.1 15,000 (example, รอยืนยัน the school's figure) + uniforms 2,500 + supplies 1,500; ป.3 extras 1,200. Monthly sinking fund: (15,000 × 2 terms + 4,000 extras × 2 + tutoring 8 weeks × 800 × 2) ÷ 12 ≈ 4,233 บาท/เดือน put aside from June. Tax: older child born 2557 → 30,000; younger born 2562 (second child, after 2561) → 60,000.
